name: Backblaze B2 Cloud Storage

regions.note: US East region (Reston, Virginia, per the data-regions doc). The code us-east-005 is the example used in the official S3-compatible API doc.

US West region; data stored in both the Sacramento and Phoenix data centers. The exact region code includes an account-specific cluster number (for example us-east-005 in the official S3 doc). Backblaze docs do not list the codes; read it from the bucket's S3 endpoint in the B2 web console and replace {nnn}.

EU Central region (Amsterdam data center). The exact region code includes an account-specific cluster number (for example us-east-005 in the official S3 doc). Backblaze docs do not list the codes; read it from the bucket's S3 endpoint in the B2 web console and replace {nnn}.

CA East region (Toronto, Ontario). The exact region code includes an account-specific cluster number (for example us-east-005 in the official S3 doc). Backblaze docs do not list the codes; read it from the bucket's S3 endpoint in the B2 web console and replace {nnn}.

storage_classes.name: B2 Cloud Storage (pay as you go)

price.note: Pricing page: 'Starts at $6.95 / TB / mo'; FAQ: billed per byte-hour 'at a rate of $6.95/TB/30-days'. Converted to per GB with 1 TB = 1,000 GB: the page does not define TB; the older line on the transaction pricing page ('$0.005/GB/month', the former $5/TB rate) implies decimal TB. Same price in all regions per the data-regions FAQ ('your data storage costs do not change'). First 10 GB free (see free_tier).

put_per_1000.note: Pricing page: 'Class A, B, and C API calls are free for pay-as-you-go customers.' Transaction pricing page lists Class A, B and C as 'Cost: Free'. PutObject/UploadPart are Class A.

get_per_1000.note: Pricing page: 'Class A, B, and C API calls are free for pay-as-you-go customers.' Transaction pricing page lists Class A, B and C as 'Cost: Free'. GetObject/HeadObject are Class B.

list_per_1000.note: Pricing page: 'Class A, B, and C API calls are free for pay-as-you-go customers.' Transaction pricing page lists Class A, B and C as 'Cost: Free'. ListObjectsV2/ListBuckets are Class C (not Class A as with other providers).

price_per_gb.note: No retrieval fee line on the pricing page (always-hot storage); absence of a line item, not an explicit statement.

typical_delay.note: Not stated; the pricing page describes the class as 'always-hot object storage'.

minimum_storage_duration_days.note: Pricing page: 'No minimum storage duration fees'.

minimum_billable_object_size_kb.note: Pricing page: 'No minimum file size fees'.

notes: Class D transactions (outbound event notifications): first 2,500 per day free, then $0.004 per 10,000 (pricing page and transaction pricing page); not modelled in requests.
The transaction pricing page still prints '$0.005/GB/month' for storage; the main pricing page ($6.95/TB/30 days) is used here as the current rate.
Capacity (1-5 year term) pricing and B2 Overdrive ($15/TB/mo, multi-petabyte commitment) are not modelled.

free_allowance_gb_per_month.note: Not a fixed amount: free egress is up to 3x the average monthly data stored (byte-hours over the billing cycle), see free_allowance_scope and egress_fair_use.

egress.free_allowance_scope: Up to 3x the account's average monthly stored data, calculated from byte-hours over the billing cycle (pricing page FAQ).

price.note: Pricing page: 'Egress beyond 3x is just $0.01/GB'; transaction pricing page: 'any additional egress priced at $0.01/GB'. Applies only after the 3x allowance.

notes: Egress above 3x is also free to or through partner CDNs and compute services (Fastly, Cloudflare, bunny.net, CacheFly, CoreWeave, Equinix Metal, Vultr, phoenixNAP), per the pricing page FAQ.
Uploads (ingress) are free: 'There is no charge to send data (upload) to Backblaze B2' (transaction pricing page).
No egress fees for Cloud Replication between regions (data-regions FAQ).

egress_fair_use.value: Free egress up to 3x the average monthly data stored (byte-hours over the billing cycle); beyond that $0.01/GB, unless downloaded through a listed CDN/compute partner.

free_tier.value: First 10 GB of storage is always free; Class A, B and C API calls are free; Class D: first 2,500 calls per day free.

object_lock.note: Object Lock (formerly File Lock) with governance and compliance modes and legal hold; 1 to 3,000 days; cannot be disabled once enabled on a bucket.

s3_endpoints.label: US East (Reston)
s3_endpoints.note: The S3 doc lists both https://bucketname.s3.<region>.backblazeb2.com and https://s3.<region>.backblazeb2.com/bucketname as valid; SDKs need only the endpoint without the bucket. Virtual-hosted is the SDK default; path-style also works. HTTPS only, SigV4 only.

s3_endpoints.label: US West
s3_endpoints.note: Endpoint format https://s3.<region>.backblazeb2.com from the S3 doc; replace {nnn} in both region and endpoint with the cluster number shown in the B2 console.

s3_endpoints.label: EU Central (Amsterdam)
s3_endpoints.note: Endpoint format from the S3 doc; replace {nnn} in both region and endpoint with the cluster number shown in the B2 console.

s3_endpoints.label: CA East (Toronto)
s3_endpoints.note: Endpoint format from the S3 doc; replace {nnn} in both region and endpoint with the cluster number shown in the B2 console.

notes: A Backblaze account is tied to one region chosen at sign-up and cannot be changed; storing data in another region needs a separate account (data-regions doc).
Tax: the pricing page does not say whether prices include tax; the help-center tax articles could not be read (HTTP 403), so prices_include_tax is null.
rclone has a native B2 backend and also works via S3; Backblaze documents rclone at https://www.backblaze.com/docs/cloud-storage-integrate-rclone-with-backblaze-b2 .
